original_test_intent: Validate the AMD tool's explicit-address correctable DRAM path for each required populated slot, proving that errormode 1 targets the intended physical DIMM and produces a corrected event without degrading memory service.
original_method: Select one approved DRAM or MCA BIOS profile; inventory UMC/channel/DIMM/rank/slot topology; reserve an OS-owned test page and translate its system physical address through interleave/hash rules; confirm `--dramecc --errormode 1` consumes that address directly; perform one CE for each approved slot; correlate exact address, syndrome/location and corrected counters across tool, MCA/EDAC/APEI or WHEA and management evidence; release the page and restore BIOS/HDT/injection state.
manual_activity: The FAE selects the RAS profile, proves the tool's explicit-address translation, maps a reserved page to each slot, performs one CE per approved target and restores the injector, HDT and BIOS state.
required_inputs: Owned reserved physical page per target and proof whether literal 0x1000 is valid
Decision whether DRAM 1.1 and MCA 1.2 are alternatives, separate checkpoints or cumulative
AMD tool/spec version/hash/license and `dramecc`, errormode 1, mcapolling 0 and errortype 0 semantics
Per-address/slot corrected MCA/EDAC/APEI/WHEA/rasdaemon/BMC oracle and timeout
BIOS threshold deviation, abort, recovery, page cleanup and restoration plan
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated ECC SUT with independent console and recoverable workload
Never inject literal 0x1000 unless current firmware/OS memory maps prove it is an owned backed page
Pin or reserve each target page so allocation/migration cannot change during the injection
Apply only the approved BIOS profile; stop on wrong slot, UCE escalation, storm, reset, poison persistence or memory degradation
No automatic retry; release test allocation and restore/diff injection, HDT and BIOS state
agent_execution_scope: Validate page ownership, address translation, topology, package provenance, event oracle and recovery
Collect read-only memory map, transcript, address-specific OS/BMC evidence and health state
Do not allocate an unsafe address, choose a profile/slot, change BIOS/HDT, inject, retry, recover automatically or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve explicit-address mapping and required slot iteration

Define address-specific evidence, timeout, abort and recovery

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Replace 0x1000 only when necessary with a reserved, decoded system physical address for the approved target, then run the literal errormode-1 CE once and preserve the address-to-event chain.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: `--dramecc --errormode 1`, 0x1000, mcapolling 0, errortype 0, both profiles, slot 1~N and 60/60 minutes are retained as source; unsafe address/profile assumptions are rejected.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use pinned test pages and a platform decoder to build a per-slot address matrix, then verify one attributable correctable event per approved slot in errormode 1.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds address ownership/lifetime, explicit-mode translation proof, profile choice, per-slot iteration, OS-specific evidence and cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single tool PASS at 0x1000 cannot show that explicit-address routing or slots 1~N were exercised.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A stale, reserved or misdecoded address may hit firmware memory, another DIMM or no DRAM, causing false evidence or instability.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source claims Memory slot 1~N but executes one explicit address 0x1000 without UMC selection or address-to-slot proof after `--listvalidumc`. The DRAM and MCA profiles conflict on counter enable and are not scoped; timeout is undefined, and Windows is offered while Criteria requires dmesg.

review_improvement: Makes explicit-address ownership and translation the core evidence, preventing one unexplained low address from standing in for physical slot 1~N coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Explicit-address injection differs from topology-directed injection because correctness depends on what address space the tool consumes and whether that page remains mapped to the intended DIMM. Interleave and hashing can distribute nearby addresses across channels, so a numeric address is not a slot identity. A low 0x1000 value may be an offset, a system address or invalid depending on tool revision; only package documentation and a live map can decide. Corrected-event evidence must carry the same address/location chain, not merely match the word ECC.
